title: Rep. Josh Gottheimer Disclosed Applied Materials and Benchmark Electronics Purchases and a Telekomunikasi Indonesia Sale (Oct 2026)
content:
Rep. Josh Gottheimer (NJ-5) disclosed three stock transactions on November 5, 2026: purchases of Benchmark Electronics (BHE, October 12) and Applied Materials (AMAT, October 26), and a sale of Telekomunikasi Indonesia (TLK, October 15), each in the $1,001–$15,000 band.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

Oct 26AMATApplied Materials, Inc.Purchase, $1,001–$15,000$387.59 vs. $372.53 (−3.89%)

Transaction dates: Oct 12, Oct 15 and Oct 26, 2026. Disclosure date: Nov 5, 2026 (10 to 24 days later). Member: Rep. Josh Gottheimer, NJ-5 (House). Updated Nov 11 to add the Telekomunikasi Indonesia sale, which was not in the data when this post was first published.

What's been disclosed

  • Two purchases: Benchmark Electronics (BHE) on October 12 and Applied Materials (AMAT) on October 26, $1,001–$15,000 each.
  • One sale: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (TLK), $1,001–$15,000, on October 15.
  • Price since: Bargo's estimate puts Benchmark Electronics about 19.8% lower on November 10 than on October 12, Applied Materials about 3.9% lower than on October 26, and Telekomunikasi Indonesia, which was sold, about 12.1% lower than on October 15.
  • Timing: the filing came 10 to 24 days after the trades, inside the 45-day window.

Quick FAQ

How long after the trades were they disclosed?
10 to 24 days after the trades, which were dated October 12, October 15 and October 26. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why are the amounts ranges?
Filings report value bands such as $15,001–$50,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

Where does the price comparison come from?
It is Bargo's estimate, comparing the price on the transaction date with the November 10 price. It is not the member's actual execution price.
